high_level_description: The image showcases the "V" shaped bridge in Moscow, Russia. The bridge is prominently featured in the foreground, curving gracefully over a body of water. The structure of the bridge is modern and sleek, with a white color that contrasts with the surrounding greenery and urban landscape. In the background, the iconic Red Square and the Kremlin are visible, with their distinctive red walls and golden domes standing out against the sky.
